parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable web search. Default value: false. In the task execution scenario (when taskExecution is passed), the task configuration prevails

parameters.help_en: The session work mode. Valid values: ask (quick Q&A), work (deep work, default), and direct (direct connection mode, which does not start the sandbox, uses independent direct history controlled by directMaxHistoryRounds, and is equivalent to directChat=true). The ask and work modes are session-level. For continued chats, the session mode is inherited by default. To switch modes, create a new session or fork. In multi-digital employee or task execution scenarios, if ask is passed, it takes effect as work. If directChat is set to true, this parameter is ignored
parameters.help_zh: 会话工作模式：ask=快速问答；work=深度工作（缺省默认）；direct=直连模式（不启动沙箱，使用独立 direct 历史，由 directMaxHistoryRounds 控制，等同 directChat=true）。ask/work 为会话级；续聊缺省继承会话模式，切换模式请新建会话或 Fork。多数字员工或任务执行场景传 ask 时按 work 生效；directChat=true 时本参数被忽略
parameters.name: work_mode

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of history rounds referenced in the current turn for the direct mode. Valid values: integers from 0 to 100. Default value: 0. Invalid values fall back to the original single-turn path. This parameter is ignored in non-direct modes
parameters.help_zh: direct 本轮最多引用的历史轮数，整数 0–100，缺省为 0；无效值沿原单轮路径，非 direct 模式忽略
parameters.name: direct_max_history_rounds
